description: This file implements routing logic for resolving agent routes based on various binding and peer constraints, including cache management, normalization, and selection strategies.

methods.name: resolveAgentRoute
methods.description: Resolves the agent route based on input parameters, considering peer, guild, team, roles, and cache.

methods.name: deriveLastRoutePolicy
methods.description: Determines whether the last route policy should be 'main' or 'session' based on session keys.

methods.name: resolveInboundLastRouteSessionKey
methods.description: Returns the appropriate session key for inbound last-route updates based on route policy.

methods.name: buildAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key for an agent, channel, account, and peer context.

methods.name: pickFirstExistingAgentId
methods.description: Selects the first existing agent ID from a list, falling back to default if none found.

methods.name: resolveAgentLookupCache
methods.description: Builds or retrieves a cache for agent ID lookups based on configuration.
